phoneScriptTemplates.courtesyOpener: Hi [Owner Name], Ameya Sharma calling from Arclane Studios, Patna. Maine aapke business [Business Name] ke liye ek custom mobile website concept design karke host kiya hai. Hum ye bilkul FREE gift offer kar rahe hain — main abhi WhatsApp par link bhej raha hoon. Agar pasand aaye toh hum aage discuss kar sakte hain, aur agar na bhi pasand aaye toh aap isse permanently FREE rakh sakte hain. No strings attached!
phoneScriptTemplates.whatsappFollowupCopy:
Namaste [Owner Name] ji! 🙏

Main Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios (Patna) se. Jaisa humne call par baat ki, maine aapke [Business Name] ke liye ek special live mobile website prototype banaya hai:

🔗 [Live Website Demo Link]

Isme direct WhatsApp booking, Google Maps location, services menu aur customer review section live integrate kar diya hai. Ye website aapke liye bilkul FREE gift hai — aap isse permanently rakh sakte hain!

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Take a quick look and let me know your thoughts!
phoneScriptTemplates.dealCloseScript: Agar aap chahein toh hum isme aapka custom .com domain, Google Search SEO listing, aur online menu/inquiry system 24 hours me live kar denge just a one-time launch support fee of ₹7,999.
